requirements.evidence: Core pieces exist (Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole models, factories, policies, livewire components, routes in routes/web.php:62-86, lang keys), but required behaviour is missing or broken: no `current_entity` middleware/alias anywhere in the diff (routes/web.php:85 dashboard route has only auth+verified); no navbar switcher link; `EntityMembershipFactory` has no employee() state (database/factories/EntityMembershipFactory.php:23-36); onboarding has no title and no 'Crie sua empresa' key (resources/lang/en/ui.php:3-9, resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:5); switcher uses a new `<x-layouts::app>` instead of the existing `default-page` (resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:1); and the change cannot run: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:45-46 leaves a stray `{` block after boot(), app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:59 uses `\Illuminate\Database\QueryException` (double backslashes), and the generated column expression in database/migrations/2026_10_29_000002_create_entity_memberships_table.php:23 is not valid SQL.

conventions.evidence: Follows some patterns ($fillable in app/Models/Entity.php:138, enum cast and local scopes in app/Models/EntityMembership.php:182-209, policies in app/Policies/), but violates several mandatory ones: no tests at all; migrations are hand-written classic classes (`class CreateEntitiesTable extends Migration`) instead of generated anonymous classes with `: void`; domain write (entity + owner creation) lives in the Livewire component instead of app/Actions/* (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:35-57); Livewire validation uses an inline rules array instead of `#[Validate]` (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:26-28); authorization bypasses policies in routes and Dashboard (routes/web.php:74-83, app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:16-19); the docs file is gutted rather than updated (docs/database-schema.md:3-5); no CHANGELOG entry; policies are registered twice (AppServiceProvider Gate::policy + a new AuthServiceProvider).

security.evidence: No unescaped output (all Blade uses `{{ }}`: resources/views/livewire/entity/dashboard.blade.php:2, resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:4-11), role is forced server-side to Owner (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:46), and entity.pick checks membership before touching the session (routes/web.php:76-79). But `EntityMembershipPolicy::delete` blocks removing the owner membership only when the actor is that owner, so an admin passes the final `return $userRole === UserRole::Owner || $userRole === UserRole::Admin;` (app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:24-33), violating 'never allowed for the owner's membership'. CreateEntity, Dashboard and entity.pick never call `$this->authorize(...)`, so authorization does not go through the policies.

tests.evidence: The entire diff adds no test file: no tests/ entry, no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for the models, policies, middleware, onboarding, dashboard, switcher or routes, and no unauthorized-call/tamper tests for the two Livewire components, despite the TDD and Livewire 'definition of done' rules.

simplicity.evidence: The onboarding slug retry is over-complicated and partly duplicated: `uniqueSlug(string $name, int $attempt = 0)` mixes an attempt counter with a separate incremental-suffix loop (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:69-82). Policy registration exists twice (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:31-32 and app/Providers/AuthServiceProvider.php:17-24), `Password::defaults` is duplicated in boot (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:34-36), and config/app.php:128-130 adds a providers array that duplicates/does not replace bootstrap/providers.php. Some logic is inline in route closures instead of reusing structure.

readability.evidence: Broken indentation and a misformed do/try block in app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:30-64 make the retry hard to follow; dead code and unused imports are left behind (`use Illuminate\Support\Arr;` in app/Models/Entity.php:132, `use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;` in app/Models/EntityMembership.php:174, `@php use App\Models\Entity;` in resources/views/livewire/entity/create-entity.blade.php:1-3, unused `use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;` at CreateEntity.php:18). EntityPolicy::create's `return $user !== null;` is a no-op (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:13). Parts are clear (small models, consistent factory/policy naming).

scope.evidence: Unrelated infrastructure crept in: HTTPS scheme forcing and a Blade anonymous component namespace in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:38-44, a whole new AuthServiceProvider plus config/app.php:128-130, duplicated Password defaults, and an unused `@php use` block. Most damaging, docs/database-schema.md is not updated but replaced: the ER diagram, relationships and modeling notes are deleted, leaving a stub (docs/database-schema.md:3-5). The task also explicitly excludes layout redesign, which the new `<x-layouts::app>` namespace is close to.

issues.explanation: The patch inserts a complete new body for boot() and then leaves the original opening brace and body after it, producing a stray `{ ... }` block at class level, which is a PHP parse error and prevents the application from booting at all.

The catch clause is written as `catch (\Illuminate\Database\QueryException $e)` with literal double backslashes, which is invalid PHP (and the correctly imported `QueryException` is never used), so the onboarding component cannot be compiled.

`generatedAs("role = 'owner' ? 1 : null")` is a PHP-style ternary, not valid SQL for a stored generated column on SQLite or MariaDB; the migration will fail, so the one-owner constraint and the whole table are never created.

No tests ship with any of the new models, policies, migrations, Livewire components or routes, violating the mandatory test-first rule and leaving the unauthorized/tamper cases for CreateEntity and Dashboard completely uncovered.

The required `current_entity` route middleware (resolving session('current_entity_id') into a tenant context, aborting 403 for non-members) and its alias are entirely absent; the dashboard route (:85) only has auth+verified and each page re-implements its own membership check.

The task requires the switcher (and other pages) to use the existing `default-page` layout, but the diff invents `<x-layouts::app>` and registers a new Blade namespace instead, so the pages render through an unrequested template and no page title is set.
The required navbar entry in the `default-page` layout (show the user's name and a link to entity.switcher only when the user has more than one membership) is not implemented anywhere in the diff.

The owner-membership guard only triggers when the actor is the owner; an admin acting on the owner's membership falls through to the final owner-or-admin return and is allowed to delete it, which the task forbids ('delete is never allowed for the owner's membership').

The change deletes the ER diagram, relationship table and modeling notes and leaves only a '## Unique Constraints (continued)' stub with one bullet, so the required schema documentation is destroyed rather than updated and the new entities/entity_memberships tables are undocumented.

A domain write (creating the entity, its owner membership, audit log and session) lives directly in the Livewire component and is not extracted to an `app/Actions/*` class, contradicting the project's Actions rule; validation is also inline instead of the `#[Validate]` pattern.

No public action calls `$this->authorize(...)` or the new policies; authorization is hand-rolled membership checks, so the Livewire 'authorize every action server-side' rule and the policies-for-authorization convention are not satisfied.

This new provider extends the framework's `Illuminate\Foundation\Providers\AuthServiceProvider` (not the Support provider that defines `$policies`/`registerPolicies()`) and calls `$this->registerPolicies()`, and the config/app.php `providers` key is not how providers are bootstrapped in current Laravel; the whole file duplicates the Gate::policy registration and is dead at best, fatal at worst.
The contract requires the states owner(), admin() and employee(); only owner() and admin() are defined, so the employee state is missing.

The onboarding page has no title and no 'Crie sua empresa' / 'Create your company' heading: the view reuses `ui.create_entity` ('Crie sua entidade') as the h1 and both locales lack the company-heading key.

The contract fixes the overridable signature as `uniqueSlug(string $name): string` called on every attempt, but the implementation adds an `$attempt` parameter and skips the uniqueness check on the first attempt, so a duplicate slug is only avoided by a failed insert and subclass overrides break LSP.
The factory derives the slug with `Str::slug($name)` without any uniqueness guarantee, although the contract requires a unique slug (collisions would violate `entities_slug_unique`).

Both migrations use the old named-class style with untyped up()/down() rather than the generator's `return new class extends Migration` with `: void`, suggesting they were hand-written instead of created with `php artisan make:migration`.
Unused imports/dead code (`Illuminate\Support\Arr`, `Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB`, and an unused `@php use App\Models\Entity;` block) add noise.
No `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG entry was added, and the session is written inside the DB transaction, so a rolled-back commit can leave a stale `current_entity_id`.

review.summary: The change builds most of the entity data model (models, enum, policies, factories, two Livewire components, language files and routes) but cannot run: a duplicated `boot()` body leaves a stray block in AppServiceProvider, the onboarding catch clause has double-escaped namespace separators, and the generated-column expression is invalid SQL. Several required pieces are missing (current_entity middleware and navbar entry, employee factory state, default-page layout, onboarding heading/text) and no tests were added, while the schema doc is destroyed rather than updated; on top of that, an admin can delete the owner membership. This needs substantial rework before it could be approved.
